credits:
Drew Brown: Guitar on tracks 3 and 9
Scott Brown: Bass on tracks 6 and 9. Bass Synth on tracks 4 and 10. Bowed Upright Bass on track 10.
Walker Johnson: Drums on tracks 2, 4, 7, and 10. Percussion on tracks 1,2,3,4,5, and 10.
Brijean Murphy: Congas and percussion on tracks 3,4,7, and 9.
Nate Salman: Everything else.

Featuring:
Brady Anderson: Cello on track 10.
Alycia Lang: Ending Vocal Choir on "Give Me My Name"
Anton Patzner: String arrangement, Violin, and Viola on track 10.
Alex Siegel: Drums and percussion on tracks 1,2, and 9. Guitar on track 2. Synth on track 8.
